# v0.9.3 evidence: the edit path on the doc itself (transact_mut_as)

Every figure cites the run that printed it (`[run JOB/RUN:field]`: the run records in
`docs/evidence/runs/`, checked by `tools/evidence/check.py`). Each section names the node, the
settings, what was timed and what was left out. Measured numbers only: no complexity class is
claimed for the new path. An edit on the doc itself costs the change plus Yrs's walk from the
root's start to the edit's position over every item, deleted ones included (`find_position`,
`types/text.rs`). So it still grows with the items before the edit, only far more slowly than
a replica of the whole doc did.

## Per-edit cost at three history sizes

`crates/base/tests/edit_cost.rs`, `edit_cost_at_sizes`, node job `5d15b747`:

- **Node and settings:** an x86_64 Linux node (4 CPUs of `--cpus 4 --mem 8G`), release,
  rustc 1.99.1. These are the baseline's settings: job `0a86a3ad`, same node and test, which
  measured the old path at 393 µs, 11.9 ms and 110 ms
  [unverified: before run records; its log lines, not a record].
- **What was timed:** through the public `Doc` API only (no session, store or fsync).
  - Each size's history is built by the test's churn: a line in at the middle of the text,
    the oldest line out, by 32 agents; the text stays about 300 lines.
  - The doc is loaded from that history.
  - **Warm:** 10 churn steps, then 200 edits timed together.
  - The history build is excluded.
- At 1.2k changes the history the test builds is checked byte-identical to the kit's own.

| History (changes) | Throwaway replica (the old path) | **On the doc itself (v0.9.3)** | Faster | Engine state (bytes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1,200 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_1200_maindoc:changes] | 391 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_1200_throwaway:per_edit_us] µs | **10 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_1200_maindoc:per_edit_us] µs** | 39× [derived] | 7,833 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_1200_maindoc:state_bytes] |
| 40,000 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_40000_maindoc:changes] | 12,009 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_40000_throwaway:per_edit_us] µs | **183 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_40000_maindoc:per_edit_us] µs** | 66× [derived] | 81,387 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_40000_maindoc:state_bytes] |
| 300,000 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_300000_maindoc:changes] | 110,413 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_300000_throwaway:per_edit_us] µs | **1,998 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_300000_maindoc:per_edit_us] µs** | 55× [derived] | 569,367 [run 5d15b747/edit_cost_300000_maindoc:state_bytes] |

Two earlier runs of the same job agree with these within a few per cent: `2ba47a74`
[unverified: before run records] and `c6cc3774`, whose canary fields the checker can't
cite (their names had digits).

| History | Check | p50 | p99 | p99.9 | max | mean (ns) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| 1.2k | 1 in 1,000 [run 5d15b747/canary_1200_1000:check_every] | 16 [run 5d15b747/canary_1200_1000:median_us] | 22 [run 5d15b747/canary_1200_1000:ninety_ninth_us] | 979 [run 5d15b747/canary_1200_1000:three_nines_us] | 2,538 [run 5d15b747/canary_1200_1000:max_us] | 17,472 [run 5d15b747/canary_1200_1000:mean_ns] |
| 40k | off | 191 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_off:median_us] | 218 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_off:ninety_ninth_us] | 246 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_off:three_nines_us] | 356 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_off:max_us] | 191,436 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_off:mean_ns] |
| 40k | 1 in 1,000 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_1000:check_every] | 187 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_1000:median_us] | 219 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_1000:ninety_ninth_us] | 13,978 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_1000:three_nines_us] | 17,953 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_1000:max_us] | 203,660 [run 5d15b747/canary_40000_1000:mean_ns] |
| 300k | off | 2,024 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_off:median_us] | 2,303 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_off:ninety_ninth_us] | 3,475 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_off:three_nines_us] | 5,084 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_off:max_us] | 2,027,521 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_off:mean_ns] |
| 300k | 1 in 1,000 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_1000:check_every] | 2,031 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_1000:median_us] | 2,376 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_1000:ninety_ninth_us] | 117,791 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_1000:three_nines_us] | 128,024 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_1000:max_us] | 2,167,548 [run 5d15b747/canary_300000_1000:mean_ns] |

**p99 overhead at the default rate:**

| History | p99 change | mean change |
|---|---|---|
| 1.2k | -8.3% (24 → 22 µs) [derived] | +13.2% [derived] |
| 40k | +0.5% (218 → 219 µs) [derived] | +6.4% [derived] |
| 300k | +3.2% (2303 → 2376 µs) [derived] | +6.9% [derived] |

- One edit in 1,000 is sampled, below the 1% that p99 reads, so the p99 change at 300k is the
  edits around a sampled one. A sampled edit costs a full encode and a throwaway replica, as
  every edit did before v0.9.3: that is the p99.9 and max.
- The first run (`2ba47a74`) put the 300k p99 at +5% [unverified: before run records].

## The 10-minute soak and its 2× check

`crates/base/tests/soak.rs`, `soak_32`, node job `a5d53680`. **The 2× check fails.**

- **Node and settings:** a build node, `--cpus 4 --mem 8G`, release, `SOAK_SECS=600`, `SOAK_SEED=1`.
- **What was timed:** the loop's calls per 30-second window. The first window is compared with
  the last 150 s; the check allows at most 2× slower. The same harness ran v0.9.1's and
  v0.9.2's soaks on the old path (8.25× and 8.89×).

| | v0.9.3 (`a5d53680`) |
|---|---|
| Calls in 600 s | 193,214 [run a5d53680/soak_32:calls] |
| Changes applied | 95,430 [run a5d53680/soak_32:applied] |
| Doc version at the end | 100,194 [run a5d53680/soak_32:version] |
| Calls/s, first window | 1,363 [run a5d53680/soak_32:first_calls_per_s] |
| Calls/s, last 150 s | 154 [run a5d53680/soak_32:tail_calls_per_s] |
| Slowdown (%; check: at most 200) | 885 [run a5d53680/soak_32:slowdown_percent] |
| Restarts | 65 [run a5d53680/soak_32:restarts] |
| Peak RSS (KiB) | 145,396 [run a5d53680/soak_32:peak_rss_kb] |

**Why it still fails** (a profiled rerun, job `b1678e27`, the same soak with timers on a
scratch branch: printed lines, not run records):

| Version (changes) | Engine edit per applied change | Store commit | Provenance map | Write-back (encode + reload the disk replica) | Engine state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ≈ 19k | 0.6 ms | 0.25 ms | 0.02 ms | | |
| ≈ 48k | 3.5 ms | 0.33 ms | 0.07 ms | 41 ms | 0.74 MB |
| ≈ 78k | 4.4 ms | 0.33 ms | 0.05 ms | 65 ms | 1.26 MB |

1. **The engine's edit is still linear in the doc's items.** Yrs finds a text position by
   walking the root's items from its start, deleted ones included (`find_position`).
   - The soak deletes lines everywhere, so its tombstones lie before every position.
   - At 78k changes the walk costs 4.4 ms per edit: about 90% of a change's kit time.
   - The replica it replaced cost far more: at 40k changes the soak ran 2.7× the v0.9.2
     soak's changes in the same time.
   - Removing it needs a position index in the engine: Yjs keeps "search markers" (recent
     positions, so a lookup walks only from the nearest marker); Yrs doesn't. That is a
     k2-yrs patch for the engine's maintainers.
2. **The file's write-back re-encodes the whole doc and reloads the disk replica from it**,
   O(the engine state): 65 ms per write-back at 1.26 MB.
   - It runs on the host's tick and on flush; the soak's `tick` calls grow from 4 to 55 ms.
   - The kit can remove it: keep the disk replica in step by applying the changes since the
     last write-back, instead of re-encoding and reloading.
3. **Blame** still makes a throwaway replica (it splits blocks); the soak blames
   periodically (0.46 ms per call on average at the end).

**At equal history the new path is far faster than the old one**: per-edit 55–68× at
40k–300k changes (above).
- The 2× check measures time windows, not history, and this run went through 2.5× as many
  changes as v0.9.2's in the same 600 s [derived].
- So v0.9.3 does **not** claim the soak condition; the measured per-edit figures stand.

## CSV `cell set` at 100k cells

C1a's `structured_mem.rs`, `measure_cell_set_latency_at_the_cap` (the structured kinds are
on branch `c1/structured`, not in this release). Node jobs `a9580183` (before) and `4553f0e6`
(after):

- **Node and settings:** a build node, `--cpus 4 --mem 8G`, release, one test thread, the same
  node for both.
- **Before:** `c1/structured` at `d19de6b` as it is: crates.io yrs, the throwaway replica.
- **After:** a scratch merge, never on `c1/structured`: `d19de6b` plus `vendor/yrs` at
  `k2-yrs-0.28.0-k2.2`, with c1's edit block switched to `transact_mut_as` on the doc
  itself (local commit `3de6ddf`).
  - The canary isn't in that block, and the structured kinds have no differential test yet.
  - Its own suite passed: 240 unit tests and the structured and table tests, job `bf9e5b75`.
- **What was timed:** 10 columns of 20-byte values; `cell set` through the `Doc` API on
  random cells by 16 clients, each edit timed alone. 100 sets at 10k, 25k and 50k cells; 300
  at the cap, 100k cells, about 2 MiB as CSV. The table build is excluded.
- The test prints milliseconds with one decimal, so these µs are multiples of 100.
- **Peak extra heap** is what one edit adds (the replica, before).

| Cells | p99 before (µs) | **p99 after (µs)** | p50 before (µs) | p50 after (µs) | Peak extra heap before (KiB) | after (KiB) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10,000 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_10000:cells] | 15,300 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_10000:ninety_ninth_us] | **100 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_10000:ninety_ninth_us]** | 13,800 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_10000:median_us] | 0 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_10000:median_us] | 6,144 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_10000:peak_extra_heap_kib] | 102 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_10000:peak_extra_heap_kib] |
| 25,000 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_25000:cells] | 41,600 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_25000:ninety_ninth_us] | **300 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_25000:ninety_ninth_us]** | 37,800 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_25000:median_us] | 100 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_25000:median_us] | 14,643 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_25000:peak_extra_heap_kib] | 205 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_25000:peak_extra_heap_kib] |
| 50,000 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_50000:cells] | 86,500 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_50000:ninety_ninth_us] | **700 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_50000:ninety_ninth_us]** | 80,400 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_50000:median_us] | 300 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_50000:median_us] | 29,286 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_50000:peak_extra_heap_kib] | 410 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_50000:peak_extra_heap_kib] |
| 100,000 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_100000:cells] | 185,100 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_100000:ninety_ninth_us] | **1,300 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_100000:ninety_ninth_us]** | 172,300 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_100000:median_us] | 800 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_100000:median_us] | 58,573 [run a9580183/before_cell_set_100000:peak_extra_heap_kib] | 819 [run 4553f0e6/after_cell_set_100000:peak_extra_heap_kib] |

C1a's target was p99 ≤ 50 ms at the cap; C1a measured 184 ms on the old path
[unverified: before run records]. When `c1/structured` is rebased on v0.9.3, its edit block
moves to the doc itself the same way (with the canary and the differential test for the
structured kinds), and this measurement is re-run on the merged code.

## Same results as the old path

- **The differential test** (`tests/edit_paths.rs`, job `5d15b747`, release): every step
  byte-identical.
  - Doc level:
    - 1,000 [run 5d15b747/edit_paths_doc:sequences] sequences;
    - 150,000 [run 5d15b747/edit_paths_doc:steps] steps;
    - 90,020 [run 5d15b747/edit_paths_doc:agent_edits] agent edits.
  - Session level:
    - 60 [run 5d15b747/edit_paths_session:sequences] sequences;
    - 9,000 [run 5d15b747/edit_paths_session:steps] steps;
    - 4,452 [run 5d15b747/edit_paths_session:engine_edits] engine edits.
  - Both sides run the same seeded sequence, the new path against the throwaway replica,
    compared at every step: updates, full state, state vector, texts.
  - At session level the comparison also covers every call's outcome, blame and log.
  - Both drivers catch both planted wrong paths.
- **The soak's shadow mode** (`SOAK_SHADOW=1`, 120 s, same job):
  - 14,795 [run 5d15b747/soak_short:calls] calls.
  - Every edit, up to version 7,673 [run 5d15b747/soak_short:version], was made through the new
    path and checked against the throwaway replica: byte-identical.
- **k2-yrs's property test** (`yrs/tests/transact_mut_as.rs`), quoted as the engine's
  maintainers asked: about 571k plain ops byte-identical with equal state vectors;
  formatting ops compared on blocks and the delete set only, because upstream orders format
  items through a randomly seeded HashMap.
  - That test prints no run record: its node jobs' summary lines are quoted below
    [unverified: no run record; the job lines are quoted].
  - Totals: 40,000 cases, 759,046 agent ops, 570,795 compared byte for byte.

## The full suite on v0.9.3

`tools/tests/full.sh`, debug. Node: a build node, `--cpus 4 --mem 8G`.

- **Code:** at `1afc798` (base-b, base-c, conformance, spec-undo) and `8df7eeb` (base-a,
  evidence); between them only tools and docs changed.
- **Engine:** each job rebuilt `vendor/yrs/src` from the public crate plus `K2.patch` and
  checked it against `VENDORED` before building.
- **Test totals:** they come from each job's `test result` lines; the tests print no run
  records. The node suite runs no measurement.
